name: Catboat Cottage
accommodation: One cottage with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, sleeping up to 8 plus an infant
suitableFor: Families and groups, including dog owners
parking: No dedicated parking stated; town-centre car park nearby
beachAccess: A stone's throw from the beach on Irsha Street
confirmedFeatures: Well-equipped kitchen, separate dining room, enclosed south-facing garden, ground-floor bedroom, en-suite
overview: A former fisherman's cottage on Irsha Street in the centre of Appledore, close to the shops, cafés and pubs and only seconds from the beach. It sleeps up to eight across four bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a separate dining room and an enclosed south-facing garden.
surfTripFit: Big enough for a group sharing costs, and the enclosed garden gives space for rinsing and drying kit; Westward Ho! is a short drive away.
